title: Reading Drill — A Guide for Low-cost Home Repairs
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Guide for Low-cost Home Repairs
passages.body:
**A** A housing group drafted instructions for simple repairs. Its first version used technical names which many readers could not match to the parts they saw at home.

**B** The editors replaced several names with drawings and tested the guide with volunteers. At each step the volunteers had to say which object they would pick up, allowing the editors to identify instructions with two possible meanings.

**C** The finished leaflet included a table listing where to ask for help. A copy was stored at the reception desk so staff could update phone numbers without redesigning the entire leaflet.
